recognize_zh: 周邊血在大量小淋巴球中混有較大、胞質較多的母細胞樣細胞；FISH 顯示 MYC 斷裂分離訊號與 ATM/TP53 訊號缺失，骨髓切片被大細胞瀰漫取代，符合 CLL 克隆演化成 DLBCL 型 Richter 轉化。
features: Peripheral blood with marked lymphocytosis: many small mature lymphocytes plus larger blast-like cells with more cytoplasm
Larger cells with open chromatin and small nucleoli, distinct from prolymphocytes
FISH with MYC break-apart probe showing separated red and green signals (rearrangement)
FISH with ATM/TP53 enumeration probe showing reduced signal numbers in some nuclei (loss)
Bone marrow biopsy with diffuse sheets of lymphoid cells replacing marrow adjacent to bony trabecula
describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood film shows marked lymphocytosis composed of small mature lymphocytes admixed with a population of larger blast-like cells with more abundant basophilic cytoplasm. Interphase FISH shows split MYC signals indicating MYC rearrangement, and ATM/TP53 enumeration reveals signal loss in a subset of nuclei. The bone marrow biopsy is diffusely replaced by a lymphoid infiltrate. Together with the flow cytometric and clonality data, findings are consistent with clonally related Richter transformation of CLL to an aggressive large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and moderate cytoplasm, and lack the diffuse large-cell marrow replacement seen here.
Accelerated CLL shows expanded proliferation centers with Ki-67 >40% but not confluent sheets of large cells.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma or high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC rearrangement
ddx.vs: Immunophenotype (CD23, cyclin D1/SOX11) and IGHV clonal relationship to the prior CLL separate these entities.
